prompt.en: In the Oath of Citizenship, what do new citizens promise about the laws of Canada?
prompt.fr: Dans le serment de citoyenneté, que promettent les nouveaux citoyens au sujet des lois du Canada?

options.en: To observe them faithfully, including the Constitution.
options.fr: De les observer fidèlement, y compris la Constitution.

options.en: To study them for one year after the ceremony.
options.fr: De les étudier pendant un an après la cérémonie.

options.en: To follow only the laws of their own province.
options.fr: De ne suivre que les lois de leur propre province.

options.en: To follow them only while they live in Canada.
options.fr: De les suivre seulement tant qu'ils vivent au Canada.

explanation.en: The oath includes a promise to observe the laws of Canada faithfully, and it names the Constitution among them. It also promises to fulfil the duties of a citizen.
explanation.fr: Le serment comprend la promesse d'observer fidèlement les lois du Canada, et il nomme la Constitution parmi celles-ci. On y promet aussi de remplir ses obligations de citoyen.

source.quote: And that I will faithfully observe The laws of Canada Including the Constitution

verification.evidence: And that I will faithfully observe The laws of Canada Including the Constitution Which recognizes and affirms The Aboriginal and treaty rights of First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples And fulfil my duties As a Canadian citizen. … Que j’observerai fidèlement Les lois du Canada Y compris la Constitution
